row.evidence: Harvest's SAML SSO FAQ says "Harvest will not be providing SCIM at this time", and admins must manually add and remove teammates in both the IdP and Harvest.
row.notes: Harvest states it does not offer SCIM; SAML SSO (Entra ID, Okta, JumpCloud, Ping Identity only, no custom IdP) is on Enterprise ($14/seat/mo billed annually). Teams is $9/seat/mo billed annually; Enterprise Plus is Contact Sales. Prices are base rates: extra invoices, projects, clients and tasks are usage-billed. With SAML required, removing a user in the IdP blocks sign-in but the Harvest seat stays until removed. Okta's only provisioning app is an Aquera-built connector (third party); Harvest's own Okta app in the OIN is SWA. The REST API v2 (all plans, including Free) can create, update, archive (is_active=false) and delete users, with Personal Access Token or OAuth2. People can also be imported by CSV or from Google Workspace.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Activity log (UI) listed on Enterprise; no audit-log API documented.

plans.name: Enterprise Plus
plans.notes: 'All Enterprise features, and' custom integrations; SSO inherited from Enterprise.

limitations.text: No SCIM: admins must manually add and remove teammates in both the IdP and Harvest.
With SAML required, removing IdP access blocks sign-in, but the Harvest seat remains until removed or reassigned.

auth.notes: OAuth2 apps choose product scope (Harvest, Forecast or both); API permissions mirror the caller's account role.

endpoints.purpose: List all users (is_active filter, up to 2000 per page)
Create a user and send an invitation email
Update a user, set access_roles, or archive/restore via is_active
Delete a user (only if no time entries or expenses)

rate_limits.text: 100 requests per 15 seconds (general); 100 requests per 15 minutes (Reports API)

limitations.text: Users with tracked time or expenses cannot be deleted, only archived; archived people still count toward billed seats until the plan is edited.

okta.notes: Harvest's own OIN app is SWA (password vaulting). Provisioning only through the Aquera-built connector. Harvest's Okta SAML guide uses a custom app (Create App Integration).

entra.notes: No gallery app: Harvest's guide creates a non-gallery SAML app; no provisioning.

google.notes: Harvest has a Google Workspace Marketplace install for Google sign-in and a people import (see fallbacks.other_sync); Google sign-in is not SAML.

jumpcloud.notes: Harvest's guide uses a JumpCloud Custom Application for SAML; no provisioning.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace people import (Directory for Google Workspace with contact sharing)
